name: Gokaldas Exports Ltd
title: Gokaldas Exports Ltd - 532630 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Management says tariff shock is behind them and guides FY27 margins up a couple of points, but capacity adds are small (~INR300-odd crore each at steady state) and working capital rose ~INR200 crore, so the supply-side read is neutral-to-positive.

utilisation.quote: The capacity utilization at BTPL is approaching nearly 50 lakh meters per month, and the mill has currently a capacity of 70 lakh meters a month

capex.peers_comment: Management said Southeast Asian and Chinese players are sitting on under-capacity utilisation and are willing to absorb cost increases.
capex.quote: many of them are sitting on under-capacity utilization

triggers.label: Tariff burden share gone from mid-Feb
triggers.quote: The tariff burden share of 15% went away from mid-February onwards.

triggers.label: FY27 margin up a couple of pts
triggers.quote: there will be a couple of percentage point improvement in margins Y-o-Y on account of the disruptions being behind us

triggers.label: Working capital up ~INR200 crore
triggers.quote: So, there is an overall increase of almost INR200 crores in working capital.

guidance.quote: there will be a couple of percentage point improvement in margins Y-o-Y on account of the disruptions being behind us
we should at least target approximately $115 million, $120 million in revenue regardless of what the AGOA status is
I anticipate that in the second half of FY '27, Africa business would have an EBITDA margin of somewhere between 8% and 10%

guidance.metric: Working capital reduction Gokaldas + Atraco FY27
guidance.quote: Our intention is to work and bring down the working capital, by at least about INR75 crores to INR100 crores in this financial year
The revenue for FY27 for that company should be in excess of INR1,000 crores
to sustain our at least 15% kind of growth, we will definitely work on the capex that is required
